content: The following are the detailed descriptions of the labels and packaging for Telavancin (Vibativ™), presented in a professional and precise manner: 1. 250 mg/Vial Label: The product is identified with the National Drug Code (NDC) 0469-3525-30. Each vial contains Vibativ™ (telavancin hydrochloride), which is equivalent to 250 mg of telavancin. The label specifies that the product is for prescription use only (Rx only). The manufacturer is Astellas. 2. 250 mg/Vial Carton: The carton is labeled with the NDC 0469-3525-30. It contains one vial, with each vial providing 250 mg of Vibativ™ (telavancin hydrochloride), equivalent to 250 mg of telavancin. The carton is marked as prescription-only (Rx only). The product is manufactured by Astellas. 3. 750 mg/Vial Label: The product is identified with the National Drug Code (NDC) 0469-3575-50. Each vial contains Vibativ™ (telavancin hydrochloride), which is equivalent to 750 mg of telavancin. The label indicates that the product is for prescription use only (Rx only). The manufacturer is Astellas. 4. 750 mg/Vial Carton: The carton is labeled with the NDC 0469-3575-50. It contains one vial, with each vial providing 750 mg of Vibativ™ (telavancin hydrochloride), equivalent to 750 mg of telavancin. The carton is marked as prescription-only (Rx only). The product is manufactured by Astellas.
